messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up: onboarding ingestion hiccup this afternoon. Need a short, segmented customer note and an internal ops checklist. Drafting here.
Jordan (Eng): Quick RCA summary: upstream webhook returned intermittent 5xxs which triggered a retry loop in our ingestion consumer. That caused duplicate jobs to be enqueued and delayed processing. Patch (retry cap + dedupe guard) rolled at 16:58 UTC. Backfill running.
Priya (Legal): Language guideline: say 'experienced a service disruption' not 'we broke something'. Also avoid promising specific monetary amounts in public messages; use 'one-time account credit where applicable'.
Sam (Support): For renewal-risk customers: request a CS-led outreach and propose standardized credits by tier. Need the tenant export to prioritize contact.
Olivia (PM): Agree on office hours and a short FAQ. Also want a small customer success survey after recovery to capture feedback.
Maria (CS): Draft for customer-facing email (non-technical):
```
Hello <CustomerName>,

We wanted to inform you of a service disruption that affected onboarding processing for a subset of customers between 16:30 and 17:00 UTC today. This impacted some onboarding steps, causing delays and, in a small number of cases, duplicate processing of tasks.

What we did:
- Deployed a fix to stop duplicated processing and added safeguards to prevent retries from creating duplicates.
- Running an automated remediation to reconcile impacted onboarding tasks; most customers should see recovery within 3	6 hours.
- Where applicable, we will apply a one-time account credit; your CS contact will reach out if you are eligible.

If youd like a live walkthrough, please join our office hours or reply to this message and well prioritize you. We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

The Redwood Inference Team
```
Jordan (Eng): Status: remediation started at 17:05 UTC, rate-limited to avoid overload. Expected finish for automated backfill ~3 hours; ~4% of tenants need manual reconciliation. Will provide full telemetry for RCA.
Priya (Legal): Approved wording with these changes: replace 'we will apply' with 'we will evaluate and apply' and remove emotive phrasing.
Maria (CS): Updated copy applied above. @InfraBot can you run the export for impacted tenant IDs (label: impacted_onboards_286543)?
InfraBot: export-run queued for dataset impacted_onboards_286543. Job ETA: 9 minutes. Job ID: EB-286543-B.
Sam (Support): Once export completes I'll create a priority queue for renewals and trials. Proposed credit tiers: trial = $50, SMB = $150, Midmarket = $500; escalate enterprise to PM for decision. CS please confirm.
Olivia (PM): I sign off on the proposed tiers for initial outreach. PM team will review enterprise cases individually. Ill also prepare the office-hours calendar and the FAQ doc.
Maria (CS): Plan: send first tranche email at 18:00 UTC to small orgs, post status page update, open office hours tomorrow 14:00 and 22:00 UTC. Sam to follow up with personalized messages for renewal-risk tenants.
Sam (Support): Subject for email: "Update: Onboarding processing incident". I'll draft the renewal outreach.
Maria (CS): Final ready-to-send message below; sending at 18:00 UTC.
```
Hello <CustomerName>,

We experienced a service disruption that affected onboarding processing for a subset of customers between 16:30 and 17:00 UTC today. Some onboarding tasks were delayed or processed more than once.

Our response:
- Fixed the processing flow and added deduplication safeguards.
- Launched an automated remediation to catch up affected onboarding jobs; most customers should be fully recovered within 3	6 hours.
- We will evaluate impacted accounts for a one-time credit and your CS contact will reach out if applicable.

If you would like a live walkthrough, join our office hours (link) or reply to this message and well prioritize you.

Were sorry for the disruption and are available for any questions.

Maria, Customer Success on behalf of Redwood Inference
```
InfraBot: export-run completed. Files: s3://redwood-exports/EB-286543-B.zip
Sam (Support): Starting renewal-risk outreach now. Posting progress in #support when first 10 are contacted.
Jordan (Eng): Ill produce a detailed engineering RCA doc and a timeline for the postmortem. Will post draft within 48h.
Maria (CS): Sending first tranche now. Closing planning thread; will reopen for RCA review and final customer followups. Thanks everyone. :pray:
